theorem cast_add [AddCommGroupWithOne R] (r : R) :
    ∀ x y : ℤφ, cast r (x + y) = cast r x + cast r y
  | ⟨a, b⟩, ⟨a', b'⟩ => by
      change ((a + a' : ℤ) : R) + (b + b') • r = _
      rw [Int.cast_add, add_zsmul, add_add_add_comm]; rfl

name: IMOSL.IMO2012A5.Generalization.ℤφ.cast_mul
statement:
theorem cast_mul : ∀ x y : ℤφ, cast r (x * y) = cast r x * cast r y
  | ⟨a, b⟩, ⟨a', b'⟩ => by
      change ↑(a * a' + b * b') + (a * b' + a' * b + b * b') • r
        = (↑a + b • r) * (↑a' + b' • r)
      rw [add_zsmul, Int.cast_add, add_add_add_comm, ← zsmul_one (b * b'),
        ← zsmul_add, add_comm 1 r, ← h, add_zsmul, ← add_assoc, mul_zsmul,
        zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_mul, ← mul_add, add_mul, add_assoc, add_right_inj,
        mul_add, ← zsmul_eq_mul', mul_zsmul, add_right_inj, mul_zsmul, zsmul_eq_mul,
        zsmul_eq_mul', zsmul_eq_mul, zsmul_eq_mul', mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc]

statement:
theorem ring_identity1 (a b c : R) :

      = (a + b + c) * (a * b + b * c + c * a)

name: IMOSL.IMO2009A2.ring_identity2

    2 * ((a * b + b * c + c * a) ^ 2 - 3 * (a * b * c * (a + b + c))) =
      (a * b - b * c) ^ 2 + (b * c - c * a) ^ 2 + (c * a - a * b) ^ 2

name: IMOSL.IMO2009A2.ring_ineq3

name: IMOSL.IMO2009C3.g_reverse

  | [] => rfl

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.P_lt_of_seed

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow_iter₁
statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₁ (k n) (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n + m, n, n] [k, n + P m c, n, n]
  | 0 => refl _
  | Nat.succ c => (cons_left (two_pow₃ _ _ hm) _).trans <|
      (append_right (type2_move _ _ _) [n]).trans (two_pow_iter₁ k n m.two_pow_pos c)

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow_iter₂
statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₂ (k n c) :

statement:
theorem two_pow_iter₃ (k n) (hc : 0 < c) :

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow_iter₄
statement: theorem two_pow_iter₄ (n) (hc : 0 < c) : isReachable [c, n, n, n] [0, n + P 1 c, n, n]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow₁
statement:
theorem two_pow₁ (k n m) : ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n + m, n] [k, n + 2 ^ c * m, n]
  | 0 => by rw [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.one_mul]; exact refl _
  | c + 1 => by
      rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]
      exact (cons_left (type1_repeat _ _ _) _).trans
        ((type2_move _ _ _).trans (two_pow₁ _ _ _ _))

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow₂
statement: theorem two_pow₂ (k n c) : isReachable [k + (c + 1), n, n] [k, n + 2 ^ (c + 1), n]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.two_pow₃
statement: theorem two_pow₃ (k n) (hc : 0 < c) : isReachable [k + c, n, n] [k, n + 2 ^ c, n]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.type1_double_repeat
statement: theorem type1_double_repeat (a b c N) : isReachable [a + N, b, c] [a, b, c + 4 * N]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.type1_repeat
statement:
theorem type1_repeat (k m) : ∀ n, isReachable [k + n, m] [k, m + 2 * n]
  | 0 => refl [k, m]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [Nat.mul_succ, ← m.add_assoc, Nat.add_right_comm]
      exact (type1_move _ _).trans (type1_repeat _ _ n)

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.isReachable.type2_repeat_drain₀
statement:
theorem type2_repeat_drain₀ (k n) : ∀ c, isReachable [k + c, n, n] [k, n, n]
  | 0 => refl _
  | c + 1 => (type2_move (k + c) n n).trans (type2_repeat_drain₀ k n c)

statement:
theorem log2_iter_add (seed n) :
    ∀ k, log2_iter seed (n + k) = log2_iter (log2_iter seed k) n
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by rw [← n.add_assoc, log2_iter_succ, log2_iter_succ, log2_iter_add]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem log2_iter_eq_zero_iff : log2_iter seed n = 0 ↔ seed < P 1 n

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_le_self
statement:
theorem log2_iter_le_self (seed) : ∀ n, log2_iter seed n ≤ seed
  | 0 => seed.le_refl
  | n + 1 => Nat.le_trans (log2_iter_le_self seed.log2 n) (Nat.log2_le_self seed)

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_lt_iff
statement:
theorem log2_iter_lt_iff {seed} (hk : 0 < k) : ∀ {n}, log2_iter seed n < k ↔ seed < P k n
  | 0 => Iff.rfl
  | n + 1 => by rw [P_succ', log2_iter, log2_iter_lt_iff hk,
      log2_lt_iff₂ (P_pos_of_seed hk n)]

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_monotone_seed
statement:
theorem log2_iter_monotone_seed (h : seed₁ ≤ seed₂) :
    ∀ n, log2_iter seed₁ n ≤ log2_iter seed₂ n
  | 0 => h
  | n + 1 => log2_iter_monotone_seed (log2_monotone h) n

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_succ
statement: theorem log2_iter_succ (seed n) : log2_iter seed (n + 1) = log2_iter seed.log2 n

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_iter_zero
statement: theorem log2_iter_zero (seed) : log2_iter seed 0 = seed

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_lt_iff₂
statement: theorem log2_lt_iff₂ {n} (hk : 0 < k) : n.log2 < k ↔ n < 2 ^ k

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_monotone
statement: theorem log2_monotone {m n : Nat} (h : m ≤ n) : m.log2 ≤ n.log2

name: IMOSL.IMO2010C4.log2_two_pow
statement:
theorem log2_two_pow : ∀ n : Nat, (2 ^ n).log2 = n
  | 0 => by simp [Nat.pow_zero, Nat.log2_def]
  | n + 1 => by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.log2_def, Nat.mul_div_left _ Nat.two_pos,
      log2_two_pow, ite_eq_left (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left 2 n.two_pow_pos)]

name: IMOSL.IMO2014N3.sum_map_replicate_two

    ∀ N, replicate (C.count 0) 0 + sum ((range N).map λ i ↦
      replicate (C.count (2 * i + 1)) (2 * i + 1)
        + replicate (count (2 * i.succ) C) (2 * i.succ)) = C.filter λ n ↦ n ≤ 2 * N
  | 0 => by
      rw [range_zero, Multiset.map_zero, sum_zero, add_zero, mul_zero]
      simp only [nonpos_iff_eq_zero]; exact (filter_eq' C 0).symm
  | N + 1 => by
      rw [range_succ, map_cons, sum_cons, add_left_comm, sum_map_replicate_two]
      ext x; rw [count_add, count_add, count_replicate,
        count_replicate, count_filter, count_filter, Nat.mul_succ]

name: IMOSL.IMO2017A7.a_and_sum_nonneg
statement:
theorem a_and_sum_nonneg : ∀ n, 0 ≤ a b n ∧ 0 ≤ (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|
  | 0 => ⟨le_refl 0, le_refl 0⟩
  | n + 1 => by
      obtain ⟨h, h0⟩

name: IMOSL.IMO2017A7.a_plus_sum_ge
statement:
theorem a_plus_sum_ge : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n + (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|
  | 0 => le_refl 0
  | n + 1 => by
    apply (add_le_add_left (a_plus_sum_ge n) 1).trans
    rw [sum_range_succ_comm, ← add_assoc, add_right_comm,
      add_le_add_iff_right, main_equality b_pos n, add_right_comm,
      add_le_add_iff_right, add_right_comm, ← Int.mul_add]
    obtain ⟨h, h0⟩

name: IMOSL.IMO2017A7.final_solution
statement:
theorem final_solution : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n ∨ (n : ℤ) ≤ a b n.succ
  | 0 => Or.inl (le_refl 0)
  | n + 1 => by
      have h0 (n) : 0 ≤ a b n

name: IMOSL.IMO2017A7.main_equality
statement:
theorem main_equality :
    ∀ n, a b n.succ = (a b n * (b n - 1) + (range n).sum λ i ↦ a b i * |b i - 2|) + 1
  | 0 => by rw [a, a, Int.zero_mul, zero_add, sum_range_zero, zero_add]
  | n + 1 => by
      rw [a, Int.mul_sub, Int.mul_one, ← add_sub_right_comm, add_sub_assoc,
        add_assoc, add_right_inj, main_equality, sum_range_succ_comm,
        ← sub_sub, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub, sub_add_cancel, ← Int.mul_sub]
      specialize b_pos n; rw [← Int.add_one_le_iff, zero_add, le_iff_eq_or_lt] at b_pos
      rcases b_pos with h | h
      · rw [ite_eq_left h.symm, ← h]; rfl
      · have h0 : 0 ≤ b n - 2
